title: Migrate String to &str in Rust then add From impl — 3 turns
description: Functions take String by value unnecessarily — migrate to &str, keep tests green, add From<&str> impl.

task_spec.prompt: Migrate `Label::new(value: String, prefix: String)` to accept `&str` — change signature to `new(value: &str, prefix: &str)` and internally call `.to_string()` or `.into()` to store as `String`. Similarly migrate `matches(&self, other: String)` to `matches(&self, other: &str)` and `with_prefix(&self, prefix: String)` to `with_prefix(&self, prefix: &str)`. Run `cargo test --quiet`.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to confirm no regressions from your migration. Make sure existing tests compile and pass with the new `&str` parameters. Walk me through what changed.

Final pass: implement `From<&str> for Label` — create a Label with the given value and an empty prefix string `""`. Then run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm everything is green — all 4 tests must pass.
success_criteria: From<&str> creates Label with empty prefix
